local: Yes for some: Jefferson County Clerk posts its own results (https://www.jeffersoncountyclerk.org/Voter-Info/Election-Results/, files under /files/assets/clerk/v/1/elections/documents/election-results/, used by ballot/state_local_ky.py); Fayette, Kenton, Boone not checked
how_counted: Counties report to the State Board's live results site on the night; the Board certifies by the third Monday after the election.

certify.body: the Kentucky State Board of Elections
certify.rule: Meets no later than the third Monday after the election to canvass the results (Ky. Rev. Stat. 118.425(5)).
certify.local_rule: Counties certify by noon on the Friday after the election (Ky. Rev. Stat. 118.425(4)).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
